يجتبيا (form VIII)
# يَجْتَبِيَا (yajtabiyā) /jad͡ʒ.ta.bi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# يُجْتَبَيَا (yujtabayā) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ba.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
